purpose: Reusable source-to-consumer contracts; independently bound adapters, storage and consumers

source.massive.bars.input: ticker + one exchange-local date + explicit adjusted basis
source.massive.bars.notes: 1 minute OHLCV, USD, America/New_York, fractional volume retained; entitlement only for observed endpoint

fetch.capture.notes: Projection is not a byte-identical API response; historical first availability unknown

local.raw.notes: No implicit durable-authoritative root; no credential or source rows in GitHub

sanitation.bars.notes: Exact duplicate collapse; conflicting duplicate rejects entire batch; no coercion, rounding, fill or resampling

verification.partition.input: raw capture + partition + pinned objects contract
verification.partition.notes: Recompute sanitation and hashes; reject incomplete artifact set, source drift, semantic mismatch and receipt edits

access.verified_partition.notes: Reverify on access; captured-at is conservative availability, not historical PIT availability; synthetic denied by default

consumer.summary.notes: Independent process imports access boundary only; summary is QC evidence, not investment output

partition.calendar: America/New_York local date, not an exchange holiday calendar
partition.completeness: Observed rows only; missing minutes are not inferred or filled

recovery.uncertain_external_fetch: inspect capture before refetch; no automatic retry

trust_boundary: Hashes bind bytes, not provider authenticity. Connector identity and capture time are caller assertions backed by separately retained execution evidence. Not tamper-proof against an actor replacing all files and pins.

reuse_families.reason: Keep Massive access outside pure qualification/storage seam
Source entity, sanitation activity, output identity and consumer provenance; not full standard conformance
Hash pins and deterministic replay; no mutable latest pointer
Fail closed on incompatible session, basis, grain and numeric data

handoffs.B02: Bind existing FETCH/QC and approved durable root; calendar/session/coverage/freshness policy, version supersession and concurrency acceptance remain open
handoffs.B00_230: Map these objects as candidate references, not accepted production bindings
handoffs.B01: Add focused suite only through existing hosted-gate ownership if accepted
